description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeTimesheetItemAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing employee timesheet entries within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, updating, and handling detailed timesheet data, along with related validation and permission checks.

classes.name: EmployeeTimesheetItemAPI
classes.description: Class providing API endpoints for managing employee timesheet entries, including retrieval and update operations within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve detailed timesheet entries along with metadata for a specific timesheet.

methods.name: getTimesheet
methods.description: Fetches the Timesheet entity by ID, ensuring access permissions, or throws exceptions if not found or unauthorized.

methods.name: getResultMetaForGetAll
methods.description: Generates metadata, including date ranges, total durations, employee info, and allowed actions for the timesheet detail response.

methods.name: getNormalizedEmployee
methods.description: Normalizes Employee entity data into an array suitable for API response.

methods.name: getNormalizedTimesheet
methods.description: Normalizes Timesheet entity data into an array formatted for API response.

methods.name: getNormalizedTotalDuration
methods.description: Converts total duration in minutes into a normalized format (hours, minutes, label).

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'getAll' API endpoint, primarily requiring a valid timesheet ID.

methods.name: getTimesheetIdParamRule
methods.description: Defines validation rule for the timesheet ID parameter.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception; creating new timesheet entries is not supported via this API.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception; no validation rules for creation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception; deletion of timesheet entries not supported via this API.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception; no validation rules for delete.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Throws not implemented exception; single fetch operation not supported.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update timesheet entries, including deletion of old entries, saving new ones, and returning updated detailed timesheet data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the update operation, requiring timesheet ID and entries data.
